response.rationale: Both forms mean a former female romantic partner. Indonesian commonly uses “mantan pacar,” while Malaysian commonly uses “bekas teman wanita”; the contrast is useful without implying exclusivity.
response.risk_rationale: “Bekas teman wanita” can sound somewhat formal or explicit compared with colloquial Malaysian alternatives.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Bekas pacar” is understandable and used in Indonesian, while “mantan pacar” is the stronger Indonesian preference; this does not undermine the Malaysian “bekas teman wanita” preference.
